title: DeathDropsPlus
description: This plugins allows you to let players give stuff to other players when killed
body:
### Death Drops Plus
THis is am extremely simple plugin that allows you to give your players items when they kill a player! It also comes with a cooldown to prevent spamming. The config is easy and there are no commands to memorise!
